openQuestions.question: Smoke regression outside this brief's acceptance: tests/e2e/greybox.spec.ts 'the stage renders the lobby within budget' @smoke fails on pixel7 only, because it samples luminance at the canvas center. With the EXPERIENCE §6.2 portrait framing (FOV 68, look-at moved to 36% of the height) the center now shows the lobby floor: 6.9/255 against its 8/255 floor (deterministic over two runs), while the framed look-at point measures 23.7/255. The spec is R8's; suggested fix for WP-17 or an R0 grant: sample at the framed look-at point (50% x 36% in portrait, 62% x 50% on desktop) or at the stage's brightest region. WP-11's lighting may move the number at integration.
openQuestions.default: greybox.spec.ts unchanged (not WP-15's path); all other @smoke tests pass (79 passed, 4 skipped)

openQuestions.question: EXPERIENCE §6.11 asks for screenPos(id) at 36% of the height on Pixel 7, but screenPos is frozen as the hit-box center (ARCHITECTURE §13.3), and that box covers plinth and case, so it lands about 9% lower than the look-at point (the case center, EXPERIENCE §6.2). camera.spec (b) asserts the case center at 62% x 50% (desktop) and 50% x 36% (Pixel 7), derived from screenPos through the measured camera, plus screenPos itself at 62% of the width on desktop. Accept this reading, or change screenPos to project the case center (a contracts-v1 change)?

openQuestions.question: Announcements: a stepping key's scroll counts as a keyboard move even when SwiftShader starts the smooth scroll more than 1 s after the keydown (keys.ts lastStepAt since the last arrival), and a HUD mark is honored for 3 s (a HUD move out of a wing scrolls only after the 1.2 s exit glide). Both are supersets of the EXPERIENCE §10.3 1 s rule; wheel, trackpad and touch never announce. OK?

Settle: CameraRig's 'moved' now also counts the gaze turn (change of the view direction at 1 m) so settled means the case is framed; the dolly, parallax and the framing shift do not hold back the settle. Confirm this reading of ARCHITECTURE §6.3 'camera moved less than 0.1 mm'.

WP-16: CameraRig asks for frames while the framing shift, the dolly or parallax damp (and on pointermove for parallax), and fade.ts wakes the rig at ink. When WP-16 replaces the interim FrameDriver, those invalidations must still render; parallax frames come from pointermove, which does not touch lastInputAt.

notes: Base: integration tip 5eb6e5c. HUD jumps: travelTo now fade-cuts any same-track move of more than 3 stops (instant scroll behind the 200 ms ink layer; no fade without a canvas), so R6's ProgressRail and 'Walk the aisle again' (travelTo('lobby'), 9 stops) already follow EXPERIENCE §6.5 without an R6 change; navigation.ts also exports jumpTo(id, { fade }) for R6 to adopt (it marks the move as a HUD move). The fade layer is the first child of #track (fixed, z-index -1 inside the track's stacking context: over the canvas, under the cards), driven by data-fade. Reduced motion: the camera holds its stop and cuts behind the fade once the scroll target is within 0.02 of another whole stop; wing entry under reduced motion fades once and announces (checked with a throwaway probe). Wing entry and exit always announce (except a wing restored at boot). Framing uses setViewOffset in px of the drawing size, so R3F's own aspect stays right on resize; with the desktop dialog open it frames into the area left of dialog.offsetLeft (the current WP-10 skeleton is full width, so this takes effect once WP-14's panel lands). Missing slice specs for WP-17 (tests/** is R8's): (1) dialog dolly about 0.6 m toward the case on open and back on close, instant under reduced motion (needs WP-14); (2) framing with the desktop panel open (look-at at the center of the area left of the panel, needs WP-14); (3) a HUD jump of more than 3 stops and 'Walk the aisle again' sample no in-between camera poses, and 1 to 3 stops scroll smoothly; (4) HUD and wing entry/exit announcements ('Entered the Projects wing. No. P1, The Climb.', 'Back in the main aisle at the Projects wing door.', 'Lobby.' after 'Walk the aisle again'); (5) the hint keys variant after a key press and its return after 8 s idle in the lobby; (6) parallax on fine pointers without ?test=1 (bounded to 1.5 and 1 degrees), which ?test=1 cannot exercise; (7) camera.spec runs on desktop and pixel7 only, (c) on desktop only (wheel and stepping keys).
